info.description:
The course covers three main parts, which including 10 Chapter

Part I: The Organized Admin: Leverage Your Unique Organizing Style to Create Systems, Reduce Overwhelm, and Increase Productivity.

Part II: Compose official documents.

Part III:  Become A Procedures Pro: The Admin's Guide to Developing Effective Office Systems and Procedures.
